turn-baker.prompt: Tripod shot, medium close-up, the framing never changes: the camera does not move, does not zoom and does not push in; the man stays the same size in the frame from the first to the last frame, with the same space above his head. Slow motion. His shoulders, torso, clothes and arms stay frozen in side profile; only his head and neck turn, very slowly and at one even speed over the whole shot, from strict side profile toward the camera, and his eyes meet the lens only at the very end. Calm, serious face, mouth closed, no talking. Same man, same dreadlocks, white paper baker hat, mint guayabera and gold chain, same plain hazy sky background. One continuous take, no cuts, no text, no logos.
